items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy geography fun-fact Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography YouTube channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, bursting with energy, like a hyped-up host who just found the craziest map fact on Earth and can't wait to show you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way. Wide, lively pitch movement: rise with real curiosity on every question, say every number with a big 'WOW' of amazement, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. Say the line 'But that's not even the weirdest part' as an excited, half-whispered secret, then burst back to full energy. Pace is quick and bouncy with short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same energy level throughout. Pronounce 'Märket' as 'MAIR-ket'. The first line is a blunt, punchy 'Did you know' hook. The last line trails off unfinished on 'Because honestly...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Accent: native General American English narrator, neutral American accent from the first word to the last. About 170 words per minute.
lines: Did you know this tiny island is half Sweden... and half Finland?
And look at the border. It's shaped like an S!
This is Märket, a bare rock between Sweden and Finland.
No trees, no people. Just three hundred fifty metres of rock.
In eighteen oh nine, Sweden lost Finland to Russia.
And the new border went straight through this island.
Then in eighteen eighty-five, the Finns built a lighthouse here.
On the highest point. All three metres of it.
One problem... that spot was in Sweden.
For a hundred years, it stood in the wrong country.
But that's not even the weirdest part.
In nineteen eighty-five, instead of moving the lighthouse...
Now it bends around the tower in a four-hundred-eighty-metre S.
And Sweden got the same amount of land back.
Plus, Finland is an hour ahead... so one step is time travel!
So... genius fix, or total madness? Because honestly...
